This script integrates information for species with available observed
sensitivity data. Specifically, it:

-   Builds a genus level phylogeny tree from the Open Tree of Life

-   Matches species to body mass data (species level, or genus fallback
    if missing)

-   Assigns functional groups (resource groups for algae, functional
    feeding groups for invertebrate, trophic guilds for fish)

The output is a combined dataset with taxonomy, phylogeny, body
mass, and assigned functional groups for each taxonomic group.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rm(list=ls())
library(here)
library(tidyverse)  
library(stringr)
library(rotl)
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(ggtreeExtra)
library(ggnewscale)
library(data.table)
library(forcats)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

options(dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE)
```

# 1. Load dataset

Read the dataset compiled from step
1_compile_observed_sensitivity_data.rmd.

```{r}
combined_observed_sensitivity <- readRDS(here("data/1_observed_sensitivity/combined_observed_sensitivity/combined_observed_sensitivity.rds"))

spe_tax_uni <- combined_observed_sensitivity %>%
  select(latin, kingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus) %>%
  mutate(
    latin = tolower(latin),
    genus = tolower(genus)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(latin)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(genus)) %>%  distinct()

# Correct species names and taxonomy
spe_tax_clean <- spe_tax_uni %>%
  mutate(
    latin_raw = latin,
    latin = tolower(latin),
    # remove bracket contents, author, strain stuff, etc.
    latin = str_replace_all(latin, "\\(.*?\\)", " "),
    latin = str_replace_all(latin, "\\[.*?\\]", " "),
    # remove cf./aff./sp./spp.
    latin = str_replace_all(latin, "\\b(cf|aff|sp|spp)\\.?\\b", " "),
    # remove "var.", "subsp.", "ssp.", "forma"
    latin = str_replace_all(latin, "\\b(var|subsp|ssp|forma|f)\\.?\\b", " "),
    # keep only two words: Genus species
    latin = str_squish(latin),
    latin = str_replace(latin, "^([a-z]+)\\s+([a-z-]+).*$", "\\1 \\2"),
    genus = str_extract(latin, "^[a-z]+")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(latin), latin != "", !is.na(genus), genus != "")
spe_tax_clean <- spe_tax_clean %>%
  mutate(
    latin = case_when(
      latin == "lithodes antarcticus" ~ "lithodes antarctica",
      latin == "Viviparus bengalensis" ~ "filopaludina bengalensis",
      latin == "acanthomysis sculpta" ~ "holmesimysis sculpta",
      latin == "acartia clausi" ~ "acartia clausii",
      latin == "acartia lillgeborgi" ~ "acartia lilljeborgii",
      latin == "acheilognathus moriokae" ~ "acheilognathus melanogaster",
      latin == "achnanthes minutissima" ~ "achnanthidium minutissimum",
      latin == "nuria danrica" ~ "esomus danrica",
      latin == "oreochromis mossambicus x urolepis" ~ "oreochromis mossambicus",
      latin == "oreochromis mossambicus x niloticus" ~ "oreochromis mossambicus", 
      latin == "enteromorpha intestinalis" ~ "ulva intestinalis", 
      TRUE ~ latin   
    )
  ) %>% distinct()

# Add broad taxonomic group: algae, invertebrate, and vertebrate
spe_tax_clean <- spe_tax_clean %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    phylum %in% c("charophyta","chlorophyta","cryptophyta","cyanobacteria",
                  "euglenozoa","haptophyta","myzozoa","ochrophyta","rhodophyta") ~ "algae",
    phylum %in% c("annelida","arthropoda","mollusca","nematoda","platyhelminthes") ~ "invertebrate",
    phylum %in% c("chordata") ~ "vertebrate",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )) %>% filter(`group` != "Other")


# Summary
length(unique(spe_tax_clean$latin))
length(unique(spe_tax_clean$genus))
spe_tax_clean %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_species = n_distinct(latin),
    n_genus   = n_distinct(genus)
  )
```

# 2. Build genus level phylogeny tree

We build a genus level phylogeny tree using the Open Tree of Life. We standardize
branch lengths using Grafen’s method and filter our dataset to only
species present in the tree. In the end of this script, we further prine thr tree to algae tree, invertebrate tree and vertebrate tree.

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

match_genus_group_tx <- function(df_group,
                                 context_name = "All life",
                                 do_approximate_matching = TRUE) {

  genus_names <- df_group %>%
    pull(genus) %>%
    unique() %>%
    as.character()

  tx_genus <- tnrs_match_names(
    names = genus_names,
    context_name = context_name,
    do_approximate_matching = do_approximate_matching
  )

  return(tx_genus)
}

df_algae <- spe_tax_clean %>% filter(group == "algae")
df_inv   <- spe_tax_clean %>% filter(group == "invertebrate")
df_vert  <- spe_tax_clean %>% filter(group == "vertebrate")

res_algae <- match_genus_group_tx(df_algae, context_name = "All life")
res_inv   <- match_genus_group_tx(df_inv,   context_name = "Animals")
res_vert  <- match_genus_group_tx(df_vert,  context_name = "Animals")

# --- Build genus level phylogeny tree ---
# algae tree
algae_ott_ids <- ott_id(res_algae)
algae_ott_in_tree <- algae_ott_ids[is_in_tree(algae_ott_ids)]
algae_tree <- tol_induced_subtree(ott_ids = algae_ott_in_tree)
algae_tree$tip.label <- tolower(res_algae$search_string[match(
    as.numeric(gsub(".*_ott", "", algae_tree$tip.label)),
    res_algae$ott_id
  )]) # use the original genus names in the phylogeny tree

# invertebrate tree
inv_ott_ids <- ott_id(res_inv)
inv_ott_in_tree <- inv_ott_ids[is_in_tree(inv_ott_ids)]
inv_tree <- tol_induced_subtree(ott_ids = inv_ott_in_tree)
inv_tree$tip.label <- tolower(res_inv$search_string[match(
    as.numeric(gsub(".*_ott", "", inv_tree$tip.label)),
    res_inv$ott_id
  )]) # use the original genus names in the phylogeny tree

# vertebrate tree
vert_ott_ids <- ott_id(res_vert)
vert_ott_in_tree <- vert_ott_ids[is_in_tree(vert_ott_ids)]
vert_tree <- tol_induced_subtree(ott_ids = vert_ott_in_tree)
vert_tree$tip.label <- tolower(res_vert$search_string[match(
    as.numeric(gsub(".*_ott", "", vert_tree$tip.label)),
    res_vert$ott_id
  )]) # use the original genus names in the phylogeny tree

# full tree
tx_full <- bind_rows(res_algae, res_inv, res_vert)
full_ott_ids <- unique(tx_full$ott_id)
length(full_ott_ids)

full_ott_in_tree <- full_ott_ids[is_in_tree(full_ott_ids)]
length(full_ott_in_tree)

full_tree <- tol_induced_subtree(ott_ids = full_ott_in_tree)
full_tree$tip.label <- tolower(tx_full$search_string[match(
    as.numeric(gsub(".*_ott", "", full_tree$tip.label)),
    tx_full$ott_id
  )]) # use the original genus names in the phylogeny tree
length(full_tree$tip.label)

# check whether prune the full tree gives same result as each group tree
pruned_full_algae_tree <- keep.tip(full_tree, intersect(full_tree$tip.label, df_algae$genus))
length(pruned_full_algae_tree$tip.label)
length(algae_tree$tip.label)
pruned_full_algae_tree$tip.label == algae_tree$tip.label

pruned_full_inv_tree <- keep.tip(full_tree, intersect(full_tree$tip.label, df_inv$genus))
length(pruned_full_inv_tree$tip.label)
length(inv_tree$tip.label)
pruned_full_inv_tree$tip.label == inv_tree$tip.label

pruned_full_vert_tree <- keep.tip(full_tree, intersect(full_tree$tip.label, df_vert$genus))
length(pruned_full_vert_tree$tip.label)
length(vert_tree$tip.label)
pruned_full_vert_tree$tip.label == vert_tree$tip.label

# standardize branch lengths using Grafen's method
algae_tree_raw <- compute.brlen(algae_tree, method = "Grafen")
inv_tree_raw   <- compute.brlen(inv_tree,   method = "Grafen")
vert_tree_raw  <- compute.brlen(vert_tree,  method = "Grafen")
full_tree_raw       <- compute.brlen(full_tree,  method = "Grafen")

# how many genus and species in the full tree
genus_in_tree <- full_tree_raw$tip.label
length(genus_in_tree)

# filter the taxonomy dataset to only species with genus in the tree
spe_tax_clean_tree <- spe_tax_clean %>%
  filter(genus %in% genus_in_tree)

# summary
length(unique(spe_tax_clean_tree$latin))
length(unique(spe_tax_clean_tree$genus))
spe_tax_clean_tree %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_species = n_distinct(latin),
    n_genus   = n_distinct(genus)
  )

# save ottds in the full tree
saveRDS(full_ott_in_tree,
        file=here("data/3_phylogeny/full_ott_in_tree.rds"))
```


# 3. Assemble body masses

We add each species with body mass estimates from a curated literature
database. The matching proceeds in two steps:

-   Species level: exact match on species name.

-   Genus level fallback: if species data are missing, we assign the
    genus average.

```{r}
sp_BM <- readRDS(here("data/4_body_mass/BM_species_summary.rds")) %>%
  mutate(
    latin = tolower(latin),
    genus = tolower(genus)
  ) %>%
  rename(BMsource = sources)

tomatch_BM <- spe_tax_clean_tree %>% select(latin, genus)

# Species-level match
species_match <- tomatch_BM %>%
  left_join(sp_BM %>% select(latin, mean_mass_g, BMsource), by = "latin") %>%
  mutate(BM_match_level = ifelse(!is.na(mean_mass_g), "species", NA))

n_species_match <- n_distinct(species_match$latin[species_match$BM_match_level == "species"])
n_species_match

# Genus-level fallback for unmatched species
# Compute genus average mass from sp_BM
genus_avg <- sp_BM %>%
  group_by(genus) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_mass_g_genus = mean(mean_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    BMsource = paste(unique(BMsource), collapse = "; "), 
    .groups = "drop"
  )

genus_match <- species_match %>%
  filter(is.na(mean_mass_g)) %>%     
  select(-BMsource) %>%
  left_join(genus_avg, by = "genus") %>%
  mutate(
    mean_mass_g = mean_mass_g_genus,
    BM_match_level = ifelse(!is.na(mean_mass_g_genus), "genus", "unmatched")
  ) %>%
  select(-mean_mass_g_genus)
n_genus_match <- n_distinct(genus_match$latin[genus_match$BM_match_level == "genus"])
n_genus_match

final_match <- bind_rows(
  species_match %>% filter(BM_match_level == "species"),
  genus_match
) %>%
  distinct(latin, .keep_all = TRUE)

match_summary <- tibble(
  total_species = length(unique(tomatch_BM$latin)),
  species_level = n_species_match,
  genus_level   = n_genus_match,
  unmatched     = length(unique(tomatch_BM$latin)) - n_species_match - n_genus_match
)

kable(match_summary)

```

After screen checking, correct species with known body mass errors
```{r}
spe_mass <- final_match %>%
  filter(BM_match_level != "unmatched") 

spe_mass <- spe_mass %>%
  mutate(
    mean_mass_g = case_when(
      str_to_lower(latin) == "nitzschia closterium"      ~ 1.58e-09, #use genus level mass
      str_to_lower(latin) == "neanthes arenaceodentata"   ~ 0.0147, #DOI: 10.1002/tox.1021
      str_to_lower(latin) == "lysmata seticaudata"       ~ 0.77, #https://doi.org/10.1007/BF00404744
      str_to_lower(latin) == "odontesthes argentinensis"  ~ 92.5, #  10.3856/vol48-issue3-fulltext-2371
      str_to_lower(latin) %in% c("oryzias melastigma",
                                 "oryzias dancena",
                                 "oryzias sinensis")      ~ 1.73, # https://doi.org/10.1007/s10695-025-01548-1
      str_to_lower(latin) == "pagrus major"               ~ 104.9, #34, Bull. Eur. Ass. Fish Pathol., 32(1) 2012
      TRUE ~ mean_mass_g
    ),
    log_mass = log10(mean_mass_g)
  )

# Remove Ulva species with weird large body mass
spe_mass <- spe_mass |> filter(!grepl("ulva", latin)) # exclude 2 species
length(unique(spe_mass$latin))
length(unique(spe_mass$genus))
```

Summary:
```{r}
# current taxonomy with both phylogeny and body mass
spe_tax_clean_tree_mass <- left_join(spe_tax_clean_tree, spe_mass %>% select(-genus), by = "latin") %>%
  filter(! is.na(log_mass))

length(unique(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass$latin))
length(unique(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass$genus))
spe_tax_clean_tree_mass %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_species = n_distinct(latin),
    n_genus   = n_distinct(genus)
  )
```

# 4. Assign functional groups

We classify species into ecological functional groups:

-   Algae → resource groups (Cyanobacteria, Diatoms, Green algae, and other algae)

-   Invertebrates → functional feeding groups (Filterer, Shredder,
    Gatherer, Herbivore, Predator)

-   Fish → trophic guilds (Herbivore, Detritivore, Planktivore, Invertivore, Omnivore, Piscivore)

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
algae_FG <- read_csv(here("data/5_FFG/algae_FG_alina.csv")) %>%
  mutate(FG_source = "Alina")

invert_vert_FG <- read_csv(here("data/5_FFG/invert_vert_FG.csv")) %>%
  mutate(algae.tax.group = NA_character_)

FG_temp <- bind_rows(algae_FG, invert_vert_FG)

spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG <- left_join(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass, FG_temp, by = "latin") %>%
  filter(! is.na(FG)) %>%
  filter(FG != "Unknown") 

```

Algae fine-scale functional groups are merged into broader categories to address limited sample sizes. 
We exclude group Parasitic as just 1 species.
For vertebrate, we combine Detritivore / Herbivore as one group.
```{r}
spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG$algae.group.2 <- dplyr::recode(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG$algae.tax.group,
  "Blue-green"      = "Cyanobacteria",
  "Green"           = "Green algae",
  "Charophytes"     = "Green algae",
  "Euglenoids"      = "Green algae",
  "Diatoms"         = "Diatom",
  "Chrysophytes"    = "Other algae",
  "Cryptomonads"    = "Other algae",
  "Dinoflagellates" = "Other algae",
  "Haptophytes"     = "Other algae",
  "Stramenopiles"   = "Other algae"
)

spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG <- spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG %>%
  mutate(FG2 = if_else(group == "algae", algae.group.2, FG)) %>%
  filter(FG != "Parasitic")

```

Summary:
```{r}
length(unique(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG$latin))
length(unique(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG$genus))
spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_species = n_distinct(latin),
    n_genus   = n_distinct(genus),
    n_FG      = n_distinct(FG2)
  )

```

# 5. Prune tree

Prune each tree to include only species with all available information.

```{r}
genlist <- spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG %>%
  select(latin, genus) %>%
  distinct()

# prune the tree to only include species in genlist
algae_tree <- keep.tip(algae_tree_raw, intersect(algae_tree_raw$tip.label, genlist$genus))
length(algae_tree$tip.label)

inv_tree <- keep.tip(inv_tree_raw, intersect(inv_tree_raw$tip.label, genlist$genus))
length(inv_tree$tip.label)

vert_tree <- keep.tip(vert_tree_raw, intersect(vert_tree_raw$tip.label, genlist$genus))
length(vert_tree$tip.label)

full_tree <- keep.tip(full_tree_raw, intersect(full_tree_raw$tip.label, genlist$genus))
length(full_tree$tip.label)
```


# 6. Save dataset
```{r}
# save the combined data for species
saveRDS(spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG, file=here("data/6_combined/spe_tax_clean_tree_mass_FFG.rds"))

# save the tree
saveRDS(algae_tree, file=here("data/6_combined/algae_genus_tree.rds"))

saveRDS(inv_tree,   file=here("data/6_combined/invertebrate_genus_tree.rds"))

saveRDS(vert_tree,  file=here("data/6_combined/vertebrate_genus_tree.rds"))

saveRDS(full_tree,      file=here("data/6_combined/full_genus_tree.rds"))


```
